hero.title: About Casagen
hero.description: The intelligent platform, developed with the expertise of a Swiss real estate expert, which allows individuals to create professional real estate listings with complete ease.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.description1: Casagen was born from a simple observation: many people encounter difficulties in writing an effective real estate listing.
mission.description2: Lack of time, lack of experience, fear of making mistakes... Our mission is to make listing creation accessible to everyone, thanks to technology and true field expertise.

expertise.title: Real expertise
expertise.description: The project is led by a real estate professional in Switzerland, holder of the federal diploma. This expertise allows us to design listings perfectly adapted to market requirements.
expertise.footerText: Technology at the service of people.
